values.name: Applicant's bank
values.description: The financial institution which is requested to issue the documentary credit.

values.name: Issuing bank
values.description: The financial institution which issues the documentary credit, if the applicant's bank is not acting as the issuing bank.

values.name: Beneficiary's bank
values.description: The financial institution with which the beneficiary maintain an account.

values.name: Beneficiary
values.description: The party in whose favour the documentary credit is to be issued and the party who must comply with the credit's terms and conditions.
